name: 10 Minute Mail
summary: Free disposable email address and inbox that self-destructs after 10 minutes, with no signup. Running since 2006.
description: A free temporary email service: every visit gets a private address and inbox that self-destructs in 10 minutes, with no signup or personal information. Messages usually arrive within seconds and can be read, replied to or forwarded, useful for signups you do not trust. The site also offers email privacy guides, a free metadata remover, service comparisons and an FAQ. Says it has operated since 2006.
